'''D-3P-O2''' was a specially-programmed [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]] responsible for managing [[Managing Director]] [[Vost Tyne]]'s schedule while he was assigned to the [[Hyperbaride/Legends|hyperbaride]] [[DSI Hyperbaride Synthesis Plant|plant]] on [[Marca/Legends|Marca]]. It had a thick accent as it had been programmed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].
